title: Driving Radar Data Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Driving_Radar_Data_Generator.md
text: Generate radar sensor detections or track reports from driving scenario or RoadRunner Scenario, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Width of actors’ cuboids (m)} sets Width of actor cuboids; {Unique identifier of sensor} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Update rate (Hz)} sets the sensor update rate, {Translation [ X, Y, Z ] relative to ego origin (m)} sets the sensor location on ego vehicle, {Rotation [Yaw, Pitch, Roll] relative to ego’s frame (deg)} sets the mounting rotation angles of radar, {Enable elevation angle measurements} enables radar to measure target elevation, {Enable range rate measurements} enables radar to measure target range rates, {Add noise to measurements} enables addition of noise to radar sensor, {Enable false reports} enables creating false alarm radar, {Enable occlusion} enables line-of-sight occlusion, {Maximum number of target reports} sets the maximum number of detections or tracks, {Target reporting format} sets the format of generated target reports, {Coordinate system}, {Source of output bus name}, {Specify an output bus name} sets the name of output bus, {Azimuth resolution (deg)} sets the azimuth resolution of radar, {Elevation resolution (deg)} sets the elevation resolution of radar, {Range resolution (m)} sets the range resolution of radar, {Range rate resolution (m/s)} sets the range rate resolution of radar, {Azimuth bias fraction}, {Elevation bias fraction}, {Range bias fraction}, {Range rate bias fraction}, {Total angular field of view [AZ, EL] (deg)} sets the angular field of view of radar, {Range limits [MIN, MAX] (m)} sets the minimum and maximum range of radar, {Range rate limits [MIN, MAX] (m/s)} sets the minimum and maximum range rate of radar, {Detection probability} sets the probability of detecting a target, {False alarm rate} sets the false alarm report rate, {Reference target range (m)} sets the reference range for given probability, {Reference target RCS (dBsm)} sets the reference radar cross-section for given probability, {Center frequency (Hz)} sets the center frequency of radar band, {Filter initialization function name} sets the kalman filter initialization function, {M and N for the M-out-of-N confirmation} sets the threshold for track confirmation, {P and R for the P-out-of-R deletion} sets the threshold for track deletion, {Random number generation} sets the method to specify random number generator, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator seed, {Target profiles definition} sets the method to specify target profiles From Scenario, {MATLAB expression for target profiles}, {Unique identifier for actors} sets the scenario-defined actor identifier, {User-defined integer to classify actors} sets the user-defined classification identifier, {Length of actors’ cuboids (m)} sets the length of actor cuboids, {Height of actors’ cuboids (m)} sets the height of actor cuboids, {Rotational center of actors from bottom center (m)} sets the rotational center of actors, {Radar cross section pattern (dBsm)} sets the radar cross-section {Azimuth angles defining RCSPattern (deg)} sets the azimuth angles of radar cross-section pattern and {Elevation angles defining RCSPattern (deg)} sets the elevation angles of radar cross-section pattern. Values come from the instance.
